|game_text='''0 side — Republic At War'''

''Deploy Forward Command Center and Begun, The Clone War Has.'' For remainder of game, Rebels and Rebel starships are lost. You may forfeit non-lightsaber weapons (using forfeit value = 3); place your just forfeited weapon in Used Pile. Your Destiny is suspended. You lose no Force to Vengeance Of The Dark Prince. While this side up, once per turn, may ▼ an [Episode I] battleground. Flip this card if a complete [Clone Army] Mission on table.

'''7 side — Aggressive Negotiations'''

Immediately, may place X cards from hand on bottom of Force Pile to draw up to X+1 cards from Reserve Deck once per game. While this side up, opponent's battle destiny draws are -1. During your control phase, may use 2 Force to ▲ a [Clone Army] character, starship or vehicle. Your total power in battles is +Y, and whenever you win a battle, retrieve up to Y Force, where Y = the number of complete [Clone Army] Missions on table. Flip this card if no complete [Clone Army] Missions on table.

* '''PC-E2''' ([[Republic At War / Aggressive Negotiations (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee card image, dated 18 February 2014 on the PC image server<ref name="srv-Virtual9-Light">Players Committee card image server, directory listing of <code>cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual9-Light/large/</code>, every card image dated 18 February 2014: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034938/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual9-Light/large/?C=M;O=A Internet Archive capture of 18 August 2019]. * '''PC-E3''' ([[Republic At War / Aggressive Negotiations (Errata 3)]]): errata of the 7 side from the Advocate Council, posted on the Players Committee forum on 8 August 2014, effective immediately (“The flip bonus has been shown to be too powerful”)<ref name="forum-p901169">Players Committee forum, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574, now titled “Current Rulings Archive August 2012 - December 2015”), post by darkjediknight11, 8 August 2014: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=40#p901169 p901169] (read 9–11 November 2026)</ref>: “Immediately place X (limit 3) cards from hand on bottom of Used Pile then draw up to X+1 cards from Reserve Deck once per game. While this side up, opponent's battle destiny draws are -1. During your control phase, may use 2 Force to ▲ a [Clone Army] character, starship or vehicle. Your total power in battles is +Y, and whenever you win a battle, retrieve up to Y Force, where Y = the number of 'complete' [Clone Army] Missions on table.. Flip this card if you have no 'complete' [Clone Army] Missions on table.” '''What changed:''' “(limit 3)” added and “Force Pile” changed to “Used Pile” (both marked in the post); the post's text also drops “may” and the comma after “Immediately”, writes “then draw” for “to draw”, puts ‘complete’ in quotes, writes “if you have no ‘complete’” for “if no complete”, and ends the second paragraph with two full stops (all kept as posted). The 0 side did not change.
